scientific_integrity: Mathematical statements are established analytically; included symbolic checks and finite-time integrations are auxiliary and are not presented as infinite proofs.
scientific_limitations: Requires strictly positive strict Prisoner's-dilemma payoff entries and proportional endpoint payoff matrices, interior initial conditions, and fixed finite capacity. General nonproportional and stochastic variants are not addressed.
title: A sharp carrying-capacity switch for proportional-payoff evolutionary resource games
